import bpy, subprocess, pathlib
EXPECTED=r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'
if bpy.data.filepath.lower()!=EXPECTED.lower(): raise RuntimeError('ABORTADO arquivo errado: '+repr(bpy.data.filepath))
# Remove somente artefatos temporarios criados pelo QA visual; nao toca geometria do projeto.
for o in list(bpy.data.objects):
    if o.name.startswith('QA_'):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
if bpy.context.scene.camera and bpy.context.scene.camera.name.startswith('QA_'):
    bpy.context.scene.camera=None
repo=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\projeto-salvador-elevador-lacerda')
subprocess.run(['git','fetch','origin','chatgpt/blender-collab'],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
for path in ('scripts/migrar_datum_vertical_59m.py','scripts/qa_world_blockout.py'):
    code=subprocess.run(['git','show','FETCH_HEAD:'+path],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
    exec(compile(code,path,'exec'),{'__name__':'__main__'})
# Save somente depois de QA PASS.
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('BATCH_0075_DATUM_59M_PASS_AND_SAVED')
